cases.name: Teresa Ponder
cases.about: Please send information about her life, dreams or interests to shecounted@gmail.com
cases.narrative:
She was an unhoused individual who frequently sought refuge on the Daybreak Ministry's steps on Walnut Street due to security cameras monitoring the area, was the victim. On the evening of May 17, 2020, Ponder settled down for the night in her usual spot at the Daybreak Ministry.

According to video surveillance, Whitehead followed her to the location and initiated an assault on her. Ponder resisted the sexual attack, leading to a struggle during which she was asphyxiated. Subsequently, Whitehead sexually assaulted her both before and after her death. Bibb County Sheriff's Deputies responded to the scene and apprehended Whitehead while he was actively sexually assaulting Ponder's lifeless body, resulting in his immediate arrest.

cases.name: India Chanel Norwood Davis
cases.about:
Family members describe Davis as a devoted mother, daughter, and sister, as well as a hardworking small business owner and former officer. They say she was widowed several years ago and leaves behind multiple children.

Loved ones say Davis dedicated her life to caring for children and families in crisis, making her death especially painful for those she served.

Cameron Bishop, president and CEO of Wesley Glen Ministries and a longtime Macon resident, said he worked with Davis at The Methodist Home for Children and Youth.

“India had a rare gift for connecting with people who were going through difficult challenges,” Bishop said. “Her impact was phenomenal. She never hesitated to speak truth to power to make sure the people she was responsible for supporting had what they needed.”

Bishop said he first learned of Davis’ death from people whose lives she had touched, a testament to the reach of her work.

He described her as a steady and patient presence for those navigating grief and trauma.

“India had the ability to sit with people in their pain, but she was also the person who celebrated with them when life went well,” Bishop said. “That kind of presence is something we too often lack.”
cases.narrative: She was found near her vehicle.
